_doc: Category 24 Dairy and Milk Products compiler config (HMTc Method v2.0, government-limit-only). Consumed by tools/standards/compile-cat24.mjs. Every certification value is the strictest applicable credible SOVEREIGN maximum in the product's native basis, selected from data/evidence/regulatory_limits.csv by explicit scope. There is NO legislated dairy reconstitution ratio, so no 8:1/1:7 conversion is ever applied here; every row is taken at face value in its native basis, and product forms (liquid vs powder vs condensed vs butterfat) are separated by SCOPE, not by the register's basis_class column (which mis-tags most fluid-milk rows as as_sold). Where the exact cell is unregulated the value is a DISCLOSED read-across from the nearest sovereign cell, an n/m determination, or a control cell — never an occurrence statistic.

Pb.label: Sovereign general-dairy read-across from Israel's 20 ug/kg lead maximum where the government register has no exact dairy-form row.

Cd.label: Sovereign general-dairy read-across from Israel's 50 ug/kg cadmium maximum where the government register has no exact dairy-form row.

tAs.label: Sovereign general-dairy read-across from Israel's 1000 ug/kg total-arsenic maximum where the government register has no exact dairy-form row.

iAs.control: Dairy regulations set total-arsenic limits, not a separate inorganic-arsenic limit. Total arsenic is measured on every lot and bounds the iAs fraction; an elevated total-As result triggers arsenic speciation.
iAs.reference_method: Total As by ICP-MS; iAs by HPLC-ICP-MS (EN 16802 or equivalent) on an elevated total-As result.

MeHg.control: There is no methylmercury bioaccumulation pathway in dairy and no sovereign dairy MeHg maximum. Total mercury is measured on every lot and bounds the methylmercury fraction.
MeHg.reference_method: Total Hg by EPA 7473 or ICP-MS; reflex MeHg speciation only if total Hg approaches the category ceiling.

tHg.label: Sovereign general-dairy read-across from Israel's 100 ug/kg total-mercury maximum where the government register has no exact dairy-form row.

Ni.label: Conservative sovereign dairy read-across from the EU liquid infant/young-child formula nickel maximum (100 ug/kg) where no general-dairy nickel maximum exists.

Sn.control: Tin is a packaging-migration analyte. Non-tinplate dairy products have no intrinsic tin pathway; products in tin-coated containers instead use the directly applicable canned/tin-coated dairy limit.
Sn.reference_method: Packaging declaration plus total Sn by ICP-MS; route tin-coated packs to the canned/tin-coated limit.

Al.label: Conservative sovereign dairy read-across from the AU-NZ non-soy infant-formula aluminium maximum (500 ug/kg); no general-dairy aluminium maximum is loaded.

Cr.label: China GB 2762 total-chromium maximum for liquid milk (300 ug/kg), directly applicable to liquid/fermented milk and used as a disclosed dairy-matrix read-across for other non-powder dairy products.

Cr-VI.control: Total chromium is measured on every lot. Any total-Cr result at or above 100 ug/kg triggers Cr(VI) speciation, and any quantifiable Cr(VI) fails certification.
Cr-VI.reference_method: Total Cr by ICP-MS; Cr(VI) by EPA 3060A with IC-ICP-MS / EN 15192 or equivalent.

dairy-milk-goat-sheep.name: Liquid milk — goat, sheep, and other ruminant
dairy-milk-goat-sheep._scope_note: Sovereign fluid-milk and general-dairy contaminant maximums are species-agnostic (no regulator sets a separate goat/sheep Pb/Cd/As/Hg limit), so this row shares the general fluid-milk/dairy sovereign pool with cow milk rather than being under-scoped to species-named rows only.

dairy-milk-camel.name: Camel milk
dairy-milk-camel._scope_note: No sovereign sets camel-milk-specific contaminant maximums. Government fluid-milk/general-dairy MLs are species-agnostic and apply to camel milk as fluid milk (a disclosed same-matrix government limit, not an occurrence analogy). The Step Zero lock's caution against cow-milk analogy applies to OCCURRENCE evidence, which this government-limit standard never uses.

dairy-yogurt-cultured.name: Yogurt and cultured dairy
dairy-yogurt-cultured._scope_note: Yogurt/cultured dairy is fermented milk at the same contaminant concentration as its milk (culturing adds no Pb/Cd/As/Hg), so it shares the general fluid-milk/dairy sovereign pool. Concentrated dairy forms (cheese, powder, condensed, butter) are excluded so their higher form-specific limits never leak in.

dairy-cream.name: Cream
dairy-cream._scope_note: Cream is a fluid-milk fraction; Pb/Cd/As/Hg are not fat-partitioned, so cream shares the general fluid-milk/dairy sovereign pool rather than being certified looser than milk on a cream-specific catch-all row. Concentrated and unrelated 'cream' products (cheese, ice cream, cosmetic creams) are excluded.

dairy-milk-powders.name: Milk powders — whole, skim, and specialty

Ni.label: Sovereign powder-basis dairy read-across from the EU non-soy infant/young-child formula nickel maximum (250 ug/kg).

Cr.label: China GB 2762 total-chromium maximum for milk and modified milk powder (2000 ug/kg).

Sn.label: EU inorganic-tin maximum for canned foods other than beverages (200000 ug/kg) applies directly to canned condensed and evaporated milk (tin migrates from the tinplate can).

butter-and-ghee.name: Butter and ghee (dairy fat)
butter-and-ghee._cross_reference: Also carried as Category 7 Row 3 (Oils, Condiments, and Specialty Foods) on the dairy-fat platform. This Category 24 Row 9 derivation is scope-aligned with the Cat 7 butter-and-ghee standard so the two never disagree; both anchor to the Vietnam QCVN 8-2:2011 dairy-fat-products sovereign limits.

Ni.control: No exact sovereign nickel maximum is loaded for solid dairy fat, and the liquid/powder infant-formula nickel read-across used elsewhere in this category does not fit an anhydrous or emulsified milk fat. Total Ni remains mandatory as surveillance and is never converted into an occurrence-selected certification value.

Al.control: No exact sovereign finished-product aluminium maximum is loaded for solid dairy fat. Total Al remains mandatory, with additive, processing-aid, soil, and equipment sources investigated.

Cr.control: No exact sovereign total-chromium maximum is loaded for solid dairy fat; the China liquid-milk chromium value does not transfer to a fat matrix. Total Cr remains mandatory and any elevated result triggers Cr(VI) speciation.
